mechanism: Sodium valproate induces UGT1A1-mediated glucuronidation of dolutegravir, reducing dolutegravir plasma concentrations by approximately 50%, potentially compromising antiretroviral efficacy.
action: Increase dolutegravir dose to 50 mg twice daily when coadministered with sodium valproate, or consider alternative anticonvulsant with minimal UGT1A1 induction.
